notes:
I wasn't able to write these notes. The research tool refused my first search with a message that no more calls were allowed this turn, so I couldn't open any of the approved sites (Enduring Word, Bible Hub, StudyLight, Precept Austin, NET Bible, New Advent and the others). You asked me to report only what those pages say and give a URL for each point. Without any pages read, anything I wrote about Zechariah 5 would come from my own memory, so I've left it all out.

When the tool is available again, I'll run the research in this order:
1. **Traditional verse-by-verse reading:** Enduring Word on Zechariah 5, and the Gill, Ellicott and Pulpit Commentary entries on Bible Hub and StudyLight, plus Precept Austin's Zechariah 5 page.
2. **Where Protestant traditions differ:** pages from each tradition's own sites (Ligonier, Monergism, The Gospel Coalition, Spurgeon.org, Desiring God, GTY, the Wesley Center, Seedbed, Lutheran Church–Missouri Synod (lcms.org), 1517) on the flying scroll, the curse and the woman in the basket.
3. **Other views:** the NET Bible notes and Bible Odyssey for modern scholarship, Catholic and Orthodox sources (New Advent's Church Fathers texts, catholic.com, oca.org), and any pages discussing popular modern teaching on these verses.

The notes would then be written verse by verse ("v. 1: ..."), with a URL after each point and verses left out where I find nothing. Just reply to ask me to try again and I'll start the searches.
